# AnimalWalker

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/animals/gait_scene.h`](../../../src/logic/animals/gait_scene.h) · Described in `data/animals.json`

An animal that walks a path of its own (straight, circle, eight, weave, or free), moved by stepWalker.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `AnimalWalker::Path` | Straight, Circle, Eight, Weave, Free (turn set by whoever drives it). |
| `speed` | `float` | m/s. |
| `radius` | `float` | Of the circle, of each loop of the eight, of the bends of the weave. |
| `turn` | `float` | Radians a metre to the left (Free). |
| `yaw` | `float` | Heading, radians about +y. |
| `travelled` | `float` | Metres walked. |
| `height` | `float` | Ground height under it. |
| `pitch` | `float` | Lean with the slope, radians. |
| `placed` | `bool` | Put on the ground once. |

## Notes

Component of AnimalWalkers' animals; also embedded in SteeredWalk (Free path), GaitWalk and the demonstrations.
